description: This file defines interfaces and types related to pod lifecycle management in Kubernetes, including admission, synchronization, eviction, and handler management.

classes.name: PodAdmitAttributes
classes.description: Context for a pod admission decision, including the pod, other pods, and the operation type.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: String type representing the operation being performed on a pod ('add' or 'resize').

classes.name: PodAdmitResult
classes.description: Result of a pod admission decision, indicating whether to admit and reasons.

classes.name: PodAdmitHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling pod admission evaluations.

classes.name: PodAdmitTarget
classes.description: Interface for managing a list of pod admit handlers.

classes.name: PodSyncLoopHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling pod sync loop operations, including whether a pod should be synced.

classes.name: PodSyncLoopTarget
classes.description: Interface for managing a list of pod sync loop handlers.

classes.name: ShouldEvictResponse
classes.description: Response indicating whether a pod should be evicted, with reasons.

classes.name: PodSyncHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling pod sync operations, including eviction decisions.

classes.name: PodSyncTarget
classes.description: Interface for managing a list of pod sync handlers.

classes.name: PodAdmitHandlers
classes.description: Slice type for managing multiple PodAdmitHandler instances.

classes.name: PodSyncLoopHandlers
classes.description: Slice type for managing multiple PodSyncLoopHandler instances.

classes.name: PodSyncHandlers
classes.description: Slice type for managing multiple PodSyncHandler instances.

methods.name: AddPodAdmitHandler
methods.description: Adds a PodAdmitHandler to the handlers list.

methods.name: AddPodSyncLoopHandler
methods.description: Adds a PodSyncLoopHandler to the handlers list.

methods.name: AddPodSyncHandler
methods.description: Adds a PodSyncHandler to the handlers list.
